Notes: [Elder Aiden McMullen] I have been seeing a lot of this script, and the wording seems a little misleading. I'm certain this is just an honest mistake and I mean no disrespect, but it is very much worth pointing out. It starts by asking if you're lonley at church but doesn't offer a solution to viewers who are lonley at our church. I'd imagine this could appear on the feed of many of our church members and cause an audience mismatch the ad doesn't account for. Also, it has odd rhetorical implications. I worry it could come off as framing other churches as inferior. For instance when we say what church is supposed to be it may seem like we are condeming the church the viewer attends, as if to say "if you're feeling lonley at your church then your church isn't what its supposed to be." The wording somewhat implies the viewer's church is at fault and instead you should come to our church. Our church has never been one to elevate itself by pushing others down and although this is certainly not the intent of the video I wory it may exsist in an accidental undertone. The idea itself is great and I think it just needs some small edits.
